### You Have VIP Access to God
Author: Whitney Hopler
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/crosswalk-devo/you-have-vip-access-to-god-the-crosswalk-devotional.html
Passage: Ephesians 3:12
Points:
- Believers have unconditional and immediate access to God through faith in Jesus.
- True confidence before God rests on Christ's finished work rather than personal performance.
- Believers never need to clean up their lives or impress God before coming to Him.
- Approaching God boldly transforms prayer into an open, honest relationship free from fear.

### Undeniable Access
Author: Sharon Jaynes
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/girlfriends/girlfriends-in-god-nov-10-2008-11595533.html
Passage: Ephesians 3:12
Points:
- While Old Testament worship kept people at a distance, Christ tore the veil to welcome believers.
- Christians can approach the Father with the freedom and confidence of a beloved child.
- When the enemy accuses believers of being unworthy, Jesus serves as our credentials.
- Believers can enter God's presence at any time without needing earthly mediators or rituals.

### No Suffering Is Unseen: Why Our Secret Pain Really Matters
Author: Vaneetha Rendall Risner
Site: Desiring God
URL: https://www.desiringgod.org/articles/no-suffering-is-unseen
Passage: Ephesians 3:10
Points:
- Private suffering is never insignificant because unseen spiritual powers observe our lives.
- Through the church, God reveals His manifold wisdom to heavenly rulers and authorities.
- Praising God through pain and weakness testifies to His supreme value before a watching cosmos.
- Trusting Christ in dark moments carries eternal significance and brings glory to God.
